issuer: District of Columbia Office of Tax and Revenue
title: OTR Tax Notice 2024-01: Recorder of Deeds Surcharge
text:
GOVERNMENT OF THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA
OFFICE OF THE CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER
OFFICE OF TAX AND REVENUE
May 15, 2024
OTR TAX NOTICE 2024-01
NOTICE REGARDING SURCHARGE
Effective July 1, 2024, the surcharge fee shall be $5.00 for any document accepted for recordation
at the Recorder of Deeds.
For additional information, please contact OTR's Customer Service Center at (202) 727-4TAX
(4829) or the Recorder of Deeds at (202) 727-5374.
